slides.heading: What it is
paras: MCP + Blender + Tripo + Claude Code together create a natural language 3D scene builder — describe what you want, get a full 3D scene. This was impossible before MCP existed.

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: Blender 4.2 LTS: blender --factory-startup -b scenes/<id>/scene.blend -f 1 exits 0 and writes a render for all three scenes.
KhronosGroup glTF-Validator: zero errors on every .glb in assets/, warnings listed.
